Share Consideration consists of (i) the number of ordinary shares of Parent, of 50 euro-cents nominal value each, equal to the Exchange Ratio; (ii) $48.75 in cash (the Exchange Consideration). The Parent Ordinary Shares may be delivered as Parent ADSs or as Parent Ordinary Shares in account-entry form; CVRs are not described in the provided excerpts.
Fixed Exchange Ratio is 2.0548; each Company Virginia Sub Common Stock share shall be exchanged for 2.0548 Parent Ordinary Shares (Share Consideration) and $48.75 in cash (Cash Consideration), i.e., the Exchange Consideration.
